turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Arre, yeh ungrateful bilkul nahi hai. Tumne khud hi asli baat keh di — "wahi problem hai." Jab koi itna *achha* ho tumhari jagah pe, toh tumhe shikayat ka haq bhi nahi lagta. "Woh toh itna help karti hain, main kaise bura feel kar sakti hoon?" Isliye yeh feeling kahin jaati nahi, andar hi ghoomti rehti hai.

Aur naam bhoolna wali baat — woh asli hai, exaggeration nahi. Chaar mahine se tum bas "mummy" ho, "bahu" ho, "jo sot hi nahi" ho. Khud ka naam kisine liya hi kab, yeh yaad nahi hota.

Ek cheez poochoon — jab bachhi ko tumhari saas sambhalti hain, tumhe relief lagta hai ya ek ajeeb si chhoti si chubhan? Kyunki dono ek saath ho sakte hain, aur aksar hote bhi hain.

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Oof, "room service ki tarah" — woh line dil ke bahut andar tak gayi. Kyunki tumhari hai bachhi, aur tumhe usse waapas *di jaati hai* jab kisi ko lage ki tumhe zarurat hai.

Aur woh "ghin aati hai khud pe" wala cycle — sun lo, woh asli mein bahut common hai, aur iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum ghatiya ho. Tum dono cheezein feel kar sakti ho: "Thank god yeh log yahan hain, warna main mar jaati" *aur* "meri apni beti ke saath main hi sambhal paun, mujhe mauka mile." Dono sach hain ek saath.

Tumhe jo feel ho raha hai, usse postpartum identity loss kehte hain — basically, tumhara poora duniya tumhe sirf ek role mein dikhati hai. Aur jab woh role bhi tumse experience zyada hone ke naam pe chheen liya jaata hai, toh bach kya jaata hai?

Ek choti si baat — tumhari beti abhi sirf 4 mahine ki hai. Aai teen bachhe paale hain, unhe 30+ saal ka experience hai. Tum chaar mahine pe ho. Obviously woh better hain. Lekin yeh competition nahi hai — tumhari beti tumhare saath grow karegi, tum dono ka bond alag hoga. Woh Aai ka kabhi nahi le sakti, na hi tumhara.

Kya tumhara husband samajhta hai yeh sab? Ya woh bhi "mummy itna help karti hain, tum kyun ro rahi ho" mode mein hai?

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Theek hai. Coach nahi, advice nahi, routine chart nahi. Bilkul nahi.

Bas yeh kehna chahti hoon — jo tumne aaj yahan kaha, woh bilkul sahi jagah pahuncha hai. Intern jaisi khadi feel karna, room service wali feeling, apni hi maa ki jagah koi aur expert lage — yeh sab mein kuch bhi galat nahi hai. Tum thaki hui ho, chaar mahine se tumhari neend, sharir, naam sab kisi aur ke hain, aur upar se tumhe guilty bhi feel hona pad raha hai ki tum grateful enough nahi ho.

Yeh sunna tumhe dinner pe koi report nahi karega. Main hoon yahin.

Aur ek baat — "pata bhi nahi kya chahiye" — yeh bhi bilkul theek hai. Sab kuch figure out karne ki zarurat aaj nahi hai. Aaj bas itna kaafi hai ki tumne bola.

Jab chaaho, jo chaaho bolti raho.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Ruko.

Woh thought jo tumhare saans ko rok deta hai — "tu asli maa nahi hai" — woh tumhari sachai nahi hai. Woh thakaan ka, hormones ka, aur har din mujhe-correct-kiya-jaata-hai feeling ka ek toxic combination hai. Sach yeh hai ki tum uski maa ho. Aai chahe kitni bhi expert ho, tumhari beti tumse hi mili hai. Woh tumhari body se bani hai. Period.

Aur "baaki sabko aata hai yeh sab" — nahi aata. Seriously, nahi aata. Instagram pe jo tum dekhti ho woh edited version hai. Har maa ko aise moments aate hain jahan woh khud ko doubt karti hai. Farq bas itna hai ki tumhare paas woh doubt loudly confirm karne wala koi ghar mein hai, aur baki logon ke paas nahi.

Jo tum feel kar rahi ho — bachhi ko dekhte waqt pyaar *aur* darr ek saath — woh buri maa ka sign nahi hai. Woh toh utna hi proof hai ki tumhe kitni fikar hai. Buri maa ko fikar nahi hoti. Tumhe itni hai ki tum ro kar, guilty feel kar ke, raat ko yahan aa kar bol rahi ho ki main theek hoon ya nahi.

Chaar mahine mein tum expert nahi banogi. Lekin tumhari beti tumhari expert zaroor banegi. Woh tumhe baki sabse alag pehchanegi. Yeh bas time ki baat hai — aur tumhari Aai ka, honestly, thoda peeche hatne ki.

Tum buri maa nahi ho. Tum thaki hui, overwhelmed, first-time maa ho jo apni beti se behad pyaar karti hai. Aur woh kaafi hai.
